data.name: BountyPop
data.detailed_description:
Hunt. Adapt. Survive.

BountyPop is a cooperative sci-fi FPS roguelite where a ragtag crew of bounty hunters travels from planet to planet hunting the galaxy's most dangerous targets. Explore mysterious worlds ruled by hostile factions, forgotten technology, and colossal bosses.

Whether you play solo or with up to 4 players, every run challenges you to adapt, improvise, and work together. Discover powerful weapons, unlock game-changing upgrades, and create unique builds.

Build Your Hunter

Every bounty hunter brings unique abilities, gadgets, and playstyles. Experiment with different combinations of weapons, skills, and upgrades to create devastating synergies and overcome increasingly dangerous encounters.

Explore Alien Worlds

Explore painterly alien worlds inspired by retro sci-fi anime, filled with ancient ruins, dangerous wildlife, hostile factions, and hidden secrets. Every contract offers new encounters and challenges to master.

Fight Together

Team up with up to 4 players in online co-op. Coordinate your abilities, revive fallen teammates, and combine your builds to take down overwhelming enemies and high-value targets.

Every Run Is Different

Procedurally generated encounters, randomized loot, evolving builds, and unpredictable events ensure no two contracts are ever the same. Learn from every defeat, unlock new possibilities, and return stronger for the next hunt.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen ore Intel equivalent.
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 / RX 5700 XT
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen ore Intel equivalent.
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 / RX 5700 XT
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
